title: entries
description: Records one under another, each a heading with its tags beside it and Markdown text the full width under them: for a name and its longer text, such as requirements, risks and what is done about them, or terms whose meaning is long, a state in a tag; a run of short decisions, the pick in a tag (a decision told with its reasons is decision, options weighed side by side are options); code goes in parts

title.description: A line of Markdown, as a table's first cell

tags.description: Short values, each a line of Markdown or a pill, as a table's cells; say in it what it is, such as merged 2026-10-30

parts.description: Parts under the text, such as code and terminal
